interventions.detail: Used Python 3.10 via uv venv; hydra-core 1.0.x / omegaconf 2.0 don't work with the system Python 3.12
pip<24.1 (and setuptools<70) so pip accepts omegaconf 2.0.x's invalid metadata; otherwise ResolutionImpossible
Installed CPU-only torch/torchaudio 2.4.1 from download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu, plus numpy<2, before the editable install with --no-build-isolation
Installed requests, which fairseq.file_utils imports to download pretrained models but setup.py doesn't declare
Top-level README translation example needs fastBPE/sacremoses, which only examples/translation/README.md mentions
